0022600199.text: The Mavericks (5-4, 3-2 at home) host the Nets (2-7) after a win, sitting 4th in the Southwest and 2.5 games back, while Brooklyn is 5th in the Atlantic, 5.5 games back, after a loss. Dallas is without Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), Sergio de Larrea (knee, strain) and Tarik Biberovic (heel, inflammation), and Brooklyn is without Egor Demin (leg, bruise) and Mikel Brown Jr. (rest), while Grant Nelson is day-to-day with a knee issue and a game-time decision. Dallas won all three meetings in 2025-26, including a 123-114 win in Brooklyn on February 24, 2026, and the teams have not met yet this season.
